WITH repeat_customers AS (
    SELECT CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
    HAVING uniqExact(SalesOrderNumber) >= 2
)
SELECT

    round(
        100 * sumIf(f.SalesAmount, rc.CustomerKey > 0) / nullIf(sum(f.SalesAmount), 0),

    ) AS repeat_customer_sales_pct
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p

INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps

INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc

GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName

WITH sales_2009 AS (
    SELECT ProductKey,
           sum(TotalCost) AS cogs
    FROM retail.FactSales
    WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01') AND DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')
    GROUP BY ProductKey
),
inv_by_day AS (
    SELECT ProductKey,
           DateKey,
           sum(OnHandQuantity * UnitCost) AS inv_value
    FROM retail.FactInventory
    WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01') AND DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')
    GROUP BY ProductKey, DateKey
),
inv_avg AS (
    SELECT ProductKey,
           avg(inv_value) AS avg_inv_value
    FROM inv_by_day
    GROUP BY ProductKey
)
SELECT s.ProductKey                      AS `产品键`,
       p.ProductName                     AS `产品名`,
       round(s.cogs, 2)                  AS `2009年销售总成本`,
       round(i.avg_inv_value, 2)         AS `2009年平均在手库存金额`,
       round(s.cogs / nullIf(i.avg_inv_value, 0), 4) AS `库存周转率`
FROM sales_2009 AS s
LEFT JOIN inv_avg AS i ON s.ProductKey = i.ProductKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
ORDER BY `库存周转率` DESC
turns.assumption: 库存周转率按语义层口径计算——分子为 2009 年该产品的全渠道销售总成本（FactSales），分母为 2009 年各快照日该产品在手库存金额（各门店 OnHandQuantity × UnitCost 求和）对快照日取的平均；只列出 2009 年有销售的产品，产品维度用左连接以保住缺失产品键的销售成本。

WITH store_product AS (
    SELECT
        f.StoreKey,
        f.ProductKey,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS product_amount
    FROM retail.FactSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d
        ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    WHERE d.CalendarYear = 2009
    GROUP BY f.StoreKey, f.ProductKey
),
store_total AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        sum(product_amount) AS store_amount
    FROM store_product
    GROUP BY StoreKey
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        sp.StoreKey,
        sp.ProductKey,
        sp.product_amount,
        st.store_amount,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY sp.StoreKey ORDER BY sp.product_amount DESC) AS rn
    FROM store_product AS sp
    INNER JOIN store_total AS st
        ON sp.StoreKey = st.StoreKey
)
SELECT
    s.StoreName AS store_name,
    r.rn AS rank_in_store,
    r.ProductKey AS product_key,
    multiIf(p.ProductKey = 0, '未知产品', p.ProductName) AS product_name,
    round(r.product_amount, 2) AS product_sales_amount,
    round(r.product_amount / nullIf(r.store_amount, 0), 6) AS share_of_store_sales
FROM ranked AS r
INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS s
    ON r.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON r.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
WHERE r.rn <= 3
ORDER BY s.StoreName, r.rn
turns.assumption: 问题中的「门店」指全渠道销售表里出现的全部门店，包含线上、目录、经销三家虚拟门店；产品销售额按 ProductKey 汇总，DimProduct 中缺失的产品键归为「未知产品」。
